package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for patch_dto_uses_non_pointer_fields_for_optional_updates: PATCH-like DTOs that cannot distinguish omitted fields from zero values.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type PatchUserRequest struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Age      int    `json:"age"`
	IsActive bool   `json:"is_active"`
	Bio      string `json:"bio"`
}

func PatchUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req PatchUserRequest
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)

	updates := map[string]interface{}{}
	if req.Name != "" {
		updates["name"] = req.Name
	}
	if req.Age != 0 {
		updates["age"] = req.Age
	}
	updates["is_active"] = req.IsActive
	updates["bio"] = req.Bio

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(updates)
}
